images.note: three-quarter vanity wall: open studs, two capped drains, dangling mirror wires, clerestory window; overcast morning
pale rift white-oak floating double vanity, honed limestone top, two round backlit mirrors
frontal shower bay: red waterproofing membrane, valve rough-in, raw framed niche; rainy night
charcoal basalt-look tile walk-in shower, linear brass drain, fluted glass, LED-lit niche with pothos
low view: tub drain rough-in, wrapped picture window, raw skylight shaft; midday overcast
freestanding cream stone tub under picture window and skylight, limewash walls, travertine floor
from hallway: two sets of supply stubs, framed mirror recess, primer patches; drizzle afternoon
walnut floating vanity with long white quartz trough sink, two black spouts, terrazzo floor
arched tub alcove cut in cement board, capped tub filler and valve; golden sun after rain
glossy cobalt-blue zellige arched tub alcove, white enamel tub, cobalt lacquer vanity, brass faucet
wide powder room: framed recess with LED wire, capped toilet flange, rosin paper; blue hour
smoked-oak vanity with stone vessel sink, backlit pill mirror in recess, fluted greige plaster

idea: Six demolished bathrooms mid-remodel in 1950s Portland mid-century ranch houses hard-cut into six finished bathrooms (white-oak double vanity with round backlit mirrors, charcoal basalt walk-in shower with lit niche, cream stone tub under a skylight, walnut trough-sink hall bath, cobalt-blue zellige arched tub alcove on the climax, smoked-oak powder room with backlit pill mirror).
